commit.description: Commit to the current state of a space repo. Not signed; authenticated by the repo host with a MAC instead.

data.description: SHA-256 digest of the repo's LtHash state.

repoWrite.description: A repo in the space advanced to a new revision.

spaceRev.description: The space revision at which this update was sequenced.

prevSpaceRev.description: The space revision before this update, if any. Set in notifySpaceUpdate, where a gap indicates missed notifications, which can be recovered with listWriters.

repoRemoved.description: A repo was removed from the writer set.

spaceRev.description: The space revision at which this update was sequenced.

prevSpaceRev.description: The space revision before this update, if any. Set in notifySpaceUpdate, where a gap indicates missed notifications, which can be recovered with listWriters.
